summary: SATEVIEW is a project concept for a 3D destination map that shows live weather for a place the user selects. Users can explore the location, see current conditions and forecasts, and check the data’s source and update time.
details:
SATEVIEW — Project Details

SATEVIEW is a proposed app that combines a 3D map with live weather for selected destinations. Users choose a place, explore its surroundings, and see local conditions and forecast details in one view.

  • 3D destination map: Shows the selected location and nearby areas.
  • Live weather: Displays current conditions and forecast information from a weather data provider.
  • Clear data details: Shows the weather source, update time, and forecast period.
  • Optional satellite context: Adds Earth observation data, such as SAR, to help explore surface changes. Satellite observations are separate from weather forecasts.

The goal is to make it easier to understand the weather at a destination before deciding where to go.
